lessons.title: Lesson 1: Inventions & Digital Devices Vocabulary
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Inventions & Digital Devices Vocabulary.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Subject + have/has + V3/ed. Used for experiences (ever, never), actions starting in the past continuing to present (since, for), and past actions with results in the present (already, just, yet).
concepts.example: Scientists have developed AI systems that can diagnose diseases faster than human doctors.
concepts.essence: Bridges past actions with their ongoing relevance or consequence in the present moment.

rules.statement: Expressing purpose: Used to V vs. Used for V-ing
rules.meaning: Both express function/purpose of an invention: 'is used to + bare infinitive' OR 'is used for + V-ing'.
rules.example: A smartphone is used to communicate with people = A smartphone is used for communicating with people.
rules.essence: Equivalent grammatical structures describing instrument functionality.

workedExamples.prompt: Put the verb into Present Perfect or Past Simple: 'Thomas Edison (invent) the light bulb in 1879. Since then, lighting technology (improve) significantly.'
steps: Step 1: 'in 1879' is a specific finished past time marker => use Past Simple: invented.
Step 2: 'Since then' connects past to present => use Present Perfect: has improved.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Present Perfect with specific past time indicators like 'yesterday', 'in 2020', 'ago'.
commonMistakes.why: Specific completed time points strictly require Past Simple.
